body.name: Clock synchronization enforced
body.description: System clocks are synchronised to a reliable source.
body.detail: Every timestamp the application writes is timezone-aware UTC, taken from the host clock.
observations: Records, audit entries and case events all use datetime.now(dt.UTC).
This matters evidentially: a timeline correlating CDR, banking and social events across sources is only sound if all of them are on one clock. Host NTP remains the agency's to maintain.
